# Vault

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A folder with all the Obsidian notes for a specific purpose, such as Ideaverse, etc.

## Scope note

Parent context for major spaces within an Obsidian linked-note system; Ideaverse recommends using major spaces: + (Add), Atlas (Knowledge), Calendar (Time), Efforts (Action), x (Extra/Support), and z (Archive).
